halts.basis: The equity floor is the envelope's automatic breaker, not bankroll preservation (full Kelly drops to half its peak about half the time). The tail-loss count is the edge's falsifier: at ~150 fills a month, 3 losses in 30 days happens about 4% of the time at the measured 0.5% rate and about 72% of the time at the ~2.5% breakeven.

orders.basis: Every order expires on its own, so a stopped desk leaves nothing resting for long; the ten-minute cycle re-rests an order before it lapses.

evidence: Backtest 2026-08-05..10-02 on Kalshi's settled results (forecasting-service content/config/temperature-markets.json records the model and its fit): at model p <= 0.01 (high) / 0.005 (low) and ask <= 0.05, 0 of 422 high and 1 of 448 low certified tails settled yes; resting sells filled about 60% (high) and 20% (low) of the time and earned +2.6c and +3.5c a contract.

riskCapital.basis: The whole Kalshi balance is the founder's walled-off, re-seedable risk stake (economics note 2026-09-01, agent + liquid + time). Kalshi contracts are fully collateralized, so no position can owe beyond its stake: inside that wall the desk sizes at full Kelly on the measured edge.

sizing.rule: full Kelly per certified tail (position-sizing-service kellyFraction) on a conservative loss rate, simultaneous bets scaled proportionally into the settlement-date budget
sizing.lossRateFloorBasis: 95% upper bounds on the backtest's settled-yes rate: 0 of 422 high (rule of three 0.7%), 1 of 448 low (1.1%).
